We are the exclusive premiere representative of leading Chinese automotive giants, including GAC Motors, JMC Motors, Dongfeng Motors, FAW Group, and Wuling Motors, within the Nigeria and Africa market.

CIG have consistently expanded our market presence nationwide through strategic partnerships and alliances, delivering a portfolio of high-quality and premium vehicles into the African market. We prioritize customer satisfaction and strive to exceed expectations. Our dedication to quality, innovation, and growth remains unwavering as we continue to shape the automotive industry landscape in Nigeria and beyond.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:&nbsp;

&nbsp;Job Position: General&nbsp;Manager, Aftersales

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary


	The GM Aftersales Workshop is responsible for the overall management, profitability, and performance of the VI&rsquo;s aftersales business encompassing service, parts, warranty, and customer support. The role ensures that all workshops operate efficiently, deliver exceptional customer satisfaction, and achieve or exceed the monthly revenue target.&nbsp;
	This position requires a strong balance of technical expertise, commercial acumen, and leadership to drive workshop productivity, optimize service quality, and enhance the company&rsquo;s reputation for reliable aftersales support across Nigeria.&nbsp;


Key Responsibilities
Business &amp; Financial Performance:&nbsp;


	Develop and execute strategies to achieve and exceed the monthly revenue target from aftersales operations (service, parts, and body shop).&nbsp;
	Monitor workshop profitability by analysing cost structures, margins, and operational efficiency.&nbsp;
	Prepare and present detailed financial reports, forecasts, and performance metrics to the Executive Director.
	Implement cost-control measures while maintaining service quality and customer satisfaction.&nbsp;


Workshop Operations Management:&nbsp;


	Oversee daily operations across all CIG Motors service centers and workshops nationwide.&nbsp;
	Ensure adherence to manufacturer standards, diagnostic procedures, and repair quality.&nbsp;
	Optimize technician productivity, workshop capacity utilization, and turnaround time (TAT).
	Enforce strict compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards.&nbsp;
	Supervise warranty claim management, ensuring timely submission and recovery from OEMs.&nbsp;


Customer Service &amp; Experience&nbsp;


	Drive customer satisfaction initiatives and ensure Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) and First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR) targets are achieved.&nbsp;
	Address escalated customer complaints promptly and professionally.&nbsp;
	Develop loyalty programs and service campaigns to retain customers and drive repeat business.
	Coordinate free service campaigns, recall management, and customer service clinics.&nbsp;


People &amp; Performance Management:&nbsp;


	Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of service managers, technicians, and support staff.&nbsp;
	Implement performance management systems to ensure high productivity and accountability.
	Identify training needs and coordinate continuous technical and soft-skill development.&nbsp;
	Promote teamwork, discipline, and a culture of operational excellence.&nbsp;


Parts &amp; Inventory Management:


	Work closely with the Parts Department to ensure adequate availability of fast moving and critical parts.
	Monitor stock levels, order cycles, and supply-chain efficiency to minimize downtime.&nbsp;
	Analyze parts sales trends and coordinate marketing efforts to increase parts turnover.&nbsp;


Strategic &amp; Operational Reporting:


	Provide the Executive Director with regular updates on workshop performance, customer feedback, and operational challenges.&nbsp;
	Propose business development opportunities &mdash; including fleet maintenance contracts, extended service plans, and corporate service partnerships.&nbsp;
	Support the Executive Director in developing long-term aftersales growth strategies and national network expansion plans. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)&nbsp;


Requirements


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Mechanical / Automotive Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.&nbsp;
	10&ndash;15 years of experience in automotive aftersales/service management, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.&nbsp;
	Strong understanding of vehicle diagnostics, OEM service standards, and workshop management systems.
	Proven ability to manage multi-location workshops and deliver consistent revenue growth.&nbsp;
	Excellent financial acumen, reporting, and analytical skills.&nbsp;
	Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.

General Manager, Aftersales Job at CIG Motors Company Limited




        
    

        
        CIG Motors Company Limited is one of the African subsidiaries of Choice International Group. We are the exclusive premiere representative of leading Chinese automotive giants, including GAC Motors, JMC Motors, Dongfeng Motors, FAW Group, and Wuling Motors, within the Nigeria and Africa market.

CIG have consistently expanded our market presence nationwide through strategic partnerships and alliances, delivering a portfolio of high-quality and premium vehicles into the African market. We prioritize customer satisfaction and strive to exceed expectations. Our dedication to quality, innovation, and growth remains unwavering as we continue to shape the automotive industry landscape in Nigeria and beyond.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 
     

            
    



 Job Position: General Manager, Aftersales

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary


	The GM Aftersales Workshop is responsible for the overall management, profitability, and performance of the VI’s aftersales business encompassing service, parts, warranty, and customer support. The role ensures that all workshops operate efficiently, deliver exceptional customer satisfaction, and achieve or exceed the monthly revenue target. 
	This position requires a strong balance of technical expertise, commercial acumen, and leadership to drive workshop productivity, optimize service quality, and enhance the company’s reputation for reliable aftersales support across Nigeria. 


Key Responsibilities
Business & Financial Performance: 


	Develop and execute strategies to achieve and exceed the monthly revenue target from aftersales operations (service, parts, and body shop). 
	Monitor workshop profitability by analysing cost structures, margins, and operational efficiency. 
	Prepare and present detailed financial reports, forecasts, and performance metrics to the Executive Director.
	Implement cost-control measures while maintaining service quality and customer satisfaction. 


Workshop Operations Management: 


	Oversee daily operations across all CIG Motors service centers and workshops nationwide. 
	Ensure adherence to manufacturer standards, diagnostic procedures, and repair quality. 
	Optimize technician productivity, workshop capacity utilization, and turnaround time (TAT).
	Enforce strict compliance with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards. 
	Supervise warranty claim management, ensuring timely submission and recovery from OEMs. 


Customer Service & Experience 


	Drive customer satisfaction initiatives and ensure Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) and First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR) targets are achieved. 
	Address escalated customer complaints promptly and professionally. 
	Develop loyalty programs and service campaigns to retain customers and drive repeat business.
	Coordinate free service campaigns, recall management, and customer service clinics. 


People & Performance Management: 


	Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of service managers, technicians, and support staff. 
	Implement performance management systems to ensure high productivity and accountability.
	Identify training needs and coordinate continuous technical and soft-skill development. 
	Promote teamwork, discipline, and a culture of operational excellence. 


Parts & Inventory Management:


	Work closely with the Parts Department to ensure adequate availability of fast moving and critical parts.
	Monitor stock levels, order cycles, and supply-chain efficiency to minimize downtime. 
	Analyze parts sales trends and coordinate marketing efforts to increase parts turnover. 


Strategic & Operational Reporting:


	Provide the Executive Director with regular updates on workshop performance, customer feedback, and operational challenges. 
	Propose business development opportunities — including fleet maintenance contracts, extended service plans, and corporate service partnerships. 
	Support the Executive Director in developing long-term aftersales growth strategies and national network expansion plans. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical / Automotive Engineering, Business Administration, or related field. 
	10–15 years of experience in automotive aftersales/service management, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role. 
	Strong understanding of vehicle diagnostics, OEM service standards, and workshop management systems.
	Proven ability to manage multi-location workshops and deliver consistent revenue growth. 
	Excellent financial acumen, reporting, and analytical skills. 
	Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management abilities.

title: Junior Recruitment Executive Job at ETL Engineering Services Limited
content:
ETL Engineering Services Limited is a premier Engineering and Technical Training company dedicated to building technical expertise across industries. At our core, we specialize in delivering hands-on engineering training programmes tailored to address the skill gaps in the Oil & Gas, Power, and Manufacturing sectors.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Junior Recruitment Executive

Job Location: Omole, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for a proactive and people-oriented Junior Recruitment Executive to join our team and play a key role in delivering our recruitment and employee outsourcing services.


What You Will Do


	Drive end-to-end recruitment, from sourcing to placement.
	Identify, screen, and engage top talent.
	Coordinate interviews and successful candidate placements.
	Manage the onboarding and deployment of outsourced employees.
	Build strong relationships with clients, candidates, and outsourced staff.
	Keep recruitment pipelines, employee records, and reports up to date.
	Resolve day-to-day recruitment and outsourcing matters efficiently.


What You Bring


	Bachelor’s degree/HND in HR, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related field.
	Minimum 2 years of experience in recruitment and outsourcing management.
	Strong sourcing, communication, and relationship-management skills.
	Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
	A proactive, solution-oriented mindset.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Junior Recruitment Executive” as the subject of the email.    

    

        Click here to Apply

  "title": "Social Media Strategist",
  "description": "Whip-Smart Service Providers Limited is an HR Recruiting Firm, bridging the gap between job seekers and employers.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Social Media Strategist&nbsp;

Job Location: Osapa Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Fashion / Luxury Fashion
Work Schedule: Hybrid &ndash; 3&ndash;4 days onsite

Job Summary


	We are seeking a creative, strategic, and data-driven Social Media Strategist to grow the brand&#39;s online presence, increase engagement, strengthen its digital identity, and convert social media audiences into customers.
	The successful candidate will take ownership of social media strategy, content planning, community engagement, campaign execution, performance tracking, and reporting across relevant platforms.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute monthly social media strategies aligned with business objectives.
	Create and manage monthly content calendars across social media platforms.
	Develop compelling captions, hooks, and calls-to-action that drive engagement and sales.
	Manage and optimize paid social media campaigns for reach, engagement, conversions, and ROI.
	Monitor social media trends, competitor activities, and platform developments.
	Stay updated on changes in social media algorithms and emerging content formats.
	Manage the online community by responding to comments, direct messages, mentions, and enquiries professionally.
	Track and analyze social media performance and provide actionable recommendations.
	Prepare regular social media performance reports.
	Collaborate with designers, content creators, videographers, and other members of the creative team.
	Ensure consistency in brand voice, messaging, and visual presentation across all platforms.
	Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness, audience growth, engagement, and sales.
	Develop social media campaigns that support product launches, promotions, and other business objectives.


Requirements


	HND or Bachelor&#39;s Degree in Mass Communication, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field.
	2&ndash;3 years of proven experience managing social media for a brand, agency, fashion business, beauty brand, or similar organization.
	Strong portfolio demonstrating audience growth, engagement, and campaign results.
	Deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant social platforms.
	Strong understanding of social media algorithms and growth strategies.
	Basic design and video editing skills using Canva, CapCut, Adobe Suite, or similar tools are required.
	Strong copywriting and storytelling skills.
	Experience managing paid social media campaigns is an advantage.
	Highly organized and able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
	Strong analytical and reporting skills.
	Creative, proactive, and results-oriented.


Salary
N300,000 &ndash; N400,000 per month.

Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV, Portfolio, and Instagram handle to: whipsmartrecruitment@gmail.com using &quot;Social Media Strategist &ndash; Lekki&quot; as the subject of the email.

Note


	For more enquiries, WhatsApp: 09131150110.
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Social Media Strategist Job at Whip-Smart Service Providers Limited




        
    

        
        Whip-Smart Service Providers Limited is an HR Recruiting Firm, bridging the gap between job seekers and employers.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Social Media Strategist 

Job Location: Osapa Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Fashion / Luxury Fashion
Work Schedule: Hybrid – 3–4 days onsite

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a creative, strategic, and data-driven Social Media Strategist to grow the brand's online presence, increase engagement, strengthen its digital identity, and convert social media audiences into customers.
	The successful candidate will take ownership of social media strategy, content planning, community engagement, campaign execution, performance tracking, and reporting across relevant platforms.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and execute monthly social media strategies aligned with business objectives.
	Create and manage monthly content calendars across social media platforms.
	Develop compelling captions, hooks, and calls-to-action that drive engagement and sales.
	Manage and optimize paid social media campaigns for reach, engagement, conversions, and ROI.
	Monitor social media trends, competitor activities, and platform developments.
	Stay updated on changes in social media algorithms and emerging content formats.
	Manage the online community by responding to comments, direct messages, mentions, and enquiries professionally.
	Track and analyze social media performance and provide actionable recommendations.
	Prepare regular social media performance reports.
	Collaborate with designers, content creators, videographers, and other members of the creative team.
	Ensure consistency in brand voice, messaging, and visual presentation across all platforms.
	Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness, audience growth, engagement, and sales.
	Develop social media campaigns that support product launches, promotions, and other business objectives.


Requirements


	HND or Bachelor's Degree in Mass Communication, Public Relations, Marketing, or a related field.
	2–3 years of proven experience managing social media for a brand, agency, fashion business, beauty brand, or similar organization.
	Strong portfolio demonstrating audience growth, engagement, and campaign results.
	Deep understanding of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant social platforms.
	Strong understanding of social media algorithms and growth strategies.
	Basic design and video editing skills using Canva, CapCut, Adobe Suite, or similar tools are required.
	Strong copywriting and storytelling skills.
	Experience managing paid social media campaigns is an advantage.
	Highly organized and able to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.
	Strong analytical and reporting skills.
	Creative, proactive, and results-oriented.


Salary
N300,000 – N400,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV, Portfolio, and Instagram handle to: [email protected] using "Social Media Strategist – Lekki" as the subject of the email.

Note


	For more enquiries, WhatsApp: 09131150110.
	Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
